declarations.name: OcelleBrandMark

members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the mark sits on: `chrome` for the dark chrome grounds (`color-chrome`, `color-chrome-hover`); absent or
any other value for the main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: tone
members.description:
`mono` paints ring and spot in `currentColor`, the colour of the surrounding text, and wins over `ground`; absent
or any other value paints the variant of `ground`. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the mark, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and without one the mark is
hidden from the accessibility tree. Not reflected.

declarations.name: OcelleListbox

members.name: label
members.description:
The listbox's accessible name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and a host `aria-label` decides
over it. Not reflected.

members.name: value
members.description:
The selected option's value, `""` when none. Setting it selects the first enabled option with the value; `""` or a
value no enabled option has clears the selection, and a non-empty such value is remembered until an option with it
appears or is enabled. A set never emits an event; setting the current value changes nothing. Not reflected.

events.name: ocelle-listbox-change
events.description: The user selected another option (Enter, Space or a click); `value` already reads it.

events.name: ocelle-listbox-activate
events.description: The user confirmed an option: Enter on the selected enabled option, or a double-click on an enabled option. Not cancelable.

declarations.name: OcelleOption

members.name: disabled
members.description:
Whether the option is disabled: it cannot be selected, the keys and the tab stop skip it, and it stays focusable,
so a focused option that becomes disabled keeps focus. Reflected.

members.name: value
members.description:
The option's value, reported by the listbox's `value` and events: the `value` attribute as written (not trimmed),
or, when it is missing or blank, the option's index among its parent's options, as a string, which is not written
to the attribute. Reflected.
members.default: the option's index, as a string

declarations.name: OcelleTabs

members.name: label
members.description:
The tablist's accessible name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none. The tabs' only name source: a host
`aria-label` does not name the tablist. Not reflected.

members.name: value
members.description:
The selected tab's value; `""` only while no tab is enabled. Setting it selects the first enabled tab with the
value; `""` or a value no enabled tab has keeps the selection, and a non-empty such value is remembered until a tab
with it appears or is enabled. A set never emits an event; setting the current value changes nothing. Not
reflected.

events.name: ocelle-tabs-change
events.description: The user selected another tab (an arrow key, Home, End, Enter, Space or a click); `value` already reads it.

declarations.description:
A tablist of `ocelle-tab` children and their `ocelle-tab-panel` panels, paired by order; one tab stop, keyboard and
pointer selection, selection following focus.

cssParts.name: tablist
cssParts.description: The row of the tabs, which wraps onto further rows.

cssParts.name: panels
cssParts.description: The container of the shown panel, beside the tablist.

attributes.name: label

attributes.name: value

value; `""` or a value no enabled tab has keeps the selection, and a non-empty such value is remembered until a tab
with it appears or is enabled. A set never emits an event; setting the current value changes nothing. Not
